invariant.portable_principle: A high branch score is a read-only structural lead, never a performance or safe-refactor verdict.

syntax: nested lambdas and class bodies excluded
runtime: host java and javac on PATH from JDK >= 17.0.0

tooling.selected: one batched Java source-launcher invocation using JavacTask, Trees, SourcePositions, and TreeScanner

rejected_alternatives.maven_or_gradle: The syntax-only outcome does not need a build-system model or dependency resolution.
rejected_alternatives.third_party_parser: The JDK already provides the bounded parse tree facts.
rejected_alternatives.shared_fact_runtime: No second Java consumer yet proves the same contract.

tooling.version_and_resolution: Discover java and javac from PATH and require both to report JDK >= 17.0.0; local verification used OpenJDK/Javac 17.0.12.
tooling.closure_mode: The Java launcher stays in the selected skill scripts directory and uses only JDK APIs.
preflight_and_failure_codes: generated/vendor/test direct target: excluded with no finding
exclusion-only target: partial artifact with visible paths

structured_outputs: findings.json with status and Java analysis metadata
outcome_contract.native_guard_command: source SHA-256 fingerprints before and after the final reporting path

known_false_positives: Dense validation or policy code can legitimately score highly.
known_false_negatives: Calls, local/anonymous class methods, type dispatch, framework conventions, and nested lambdas are intentionally not scored.
legitimate_similar_shapes: Kotlin source produces partial unsupported evidence rather than a Java or JVM claim.

did_not_generalize: a universal parser or shared fact platform

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: JDK toolchain bootstrap and compiler-tree batch
evidence: Only this detector needs the exact syntax-only direct-body score today.

residual_risks: Preview/newer Java syntax is limited by the discovered host JDK.
The pilot does not interpret source sets, modules, annotation processing, or generated build inputs.

next_decision.recommendation: Use this fixture and JDK preflight pattern for the Java proposal pilot, but derive only the richer facts that proposal-boundary actually needs.
next_decision.rationale: The final detector outcome is useful without creating a shared Java platform or overstating JVM coverage.
